status: Exploratory offline experiment; never a production or frozen-SOR replacement
question: After individual opponent results and venue are accounted for, is there a residual FBS-FCS probability calibration error?
currentSeason: 2026 snapshot is ranking-impact illustration only, never a fitted input or validation target
cutoff: Before earliest target-week kickoff; only earlier processed weeks with kickoff plus 24 hours at or before cutoff. Corrected retrospective data, not archived real-time availability.
network: Existing Colley, regularization 2, all eligible source nodes; identical network for each nested comparison
primaryFitPopulation: Untied FBS-FBS and FBS-FCS games with both subdivisions explicitly known

models.frozenOriginal: Existing frozen slope/home mapping, gap zero; context only
models.refitControl: Fit slope and home coefficient on the same primary training games as challenger
models.divisionResidual: Fit slope, home coefficient, and signed FBS-versus-FCS indicator; no intercept, no sign restriction, no team or conference effects

sensitivities: FBS/FCS-only network, identical known-D1 target games
Regular-season-only graph and targets to reduce unequal postseason coverage
All known-D1 calibration games rather than only FBS-involving games; primary full-source network
report: Per-year and pooled log loss, Brier and mean predicted/observed rates
FCS-FCS diagnostic outside primary fitting population
Fewer-than-four available games and later crossdivision samples; preweek means prior games, excluded-game context means all other final-network games
Paired week-block score resampling and coefficient stability; descriptive, not calibrated confidence intervals
Current snapshot SOR impact using excluded-game coefficients only
dataLimits: Historical source labels are season-specific and retrospective; not universal NCAA certification
FCS postseason missing or incomplete, lower-division coverage changes substantially across years
2020 pandemic coverage and FBS roster omissions require separate stress reporting
Selected crossdivision schedules and predominantly FBS home venues prevent a causal population talent-gap interpretation
interpretation: A positive residual can improve selected-game probability calibration without proving a better achievement order. A residual may compensate for shrinkage or incomplete context. Do not double-count by also applying a division penalty to the network or win totals.
decision: Report evidence and limitations; no automatic promotion, poll matching, parameters chosen by 2026 rank appearance, deployment, CFBD calls or paid services
